title: Swedish intervention in the Thirty Years' War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Swedish intervention in the Thirty Years' War", at revision 1379631827, opens: "Swedish intervention in the Thirty Years' War began in July 1630 when troops under Gustavus Adolphus landed in Pomerania. Under his leadership, the Protestant cause, previously on the verge of defeat, won several major victories and changed the direction of the war." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7655000, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Swedish phase of the Thirty Years' War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
